name: @trebeljahr/vibestats
description: Local dashboard for Claude Code + Codex + claude.ai web chat usage. GitHub-style heatmap, per-day token + cost breakdown, value-vs-subscription multiple.

scripts.release:patch: node scripts/release-prep.mjs && node scripts/release-bump.mjs patch && npm run _release:finish
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/release-prep.mjs && node scripts/release-bump.mjs minor && npm run _release:finish
scripts.release:major: node scripts/release-prep.mjs && node scripts/release-bump.mjs major && npm run _release:finish
scripts._release:finish: git push --follow-tags && npm publish --provenance --access public && npm install -g .

author: Rico Trebeljahr
